absolute_product_gate.source: 30 FPS product latency and throughput floor frozen before baseline results

boundary_contract.D: completed native render output through payload delivery only; diagnostic and never a replacement gate
boundary_contract.I: published frame available through zero-copy native input binding and device-side dependency enqueue
boundary_contract.R0: native world-space scene plus fixed BVH topology/order through native render completion
boundary_contract.R1: native body transforms plus native local scene through update, acceleration, render, lease bookkeeping, and native completion
boundary_contract.R2: fresh complete R1 transaction followed by payload-specific delivery and its terminal reclaim/drain endpoint
boundary_contract.S: immediately before GpuEngine.step through payload readiness, consumer completion, slot reclaim, and final batch reclaim

fixed_r0_topology_contract.lane_rule: both lanes receive independently allocated copies of the same normalized topology arrays
fixed_r0_topology_contract.run_manifest_requirement: record and compare topology_sha256 before timing

payload_byte_contract.full: width * height * 101 canonical per-ray host bytes plus four int32 scalar diagnostics
payload_byte_contract.opt_in_diagnostic_overlay: shadow_traversal_counters_v1 adds nine int32 scalar arrays only when traversal diagnostics are requested; it is excluded from primary payload byte gates
payload_byte_contract.rgb: width * height * 3 * sizeof(float32) plus four int32 scalar diagnostics
payload_byte_contract.rgb8: width * height * 3 * sizeof(uint8) plus four int32 scalar diagnostics
payload_byte_contract.scope: every per-ray and scalar array delivered by the primary unprofiled row
